learning_outcomes.text: Know how to identify the basic aspects of a system, breaking it down into functional units and describing its operation.

Develop personal initiative, creativity, dynamism, critical thinking and many other values that make people active in the face of their surrounding circumstances. Gather technical information related to a topic and efficiently allocate the necessary resources for a specific task, with appropriate timing.
Use an appropriate logical structure and correct language suitable for each situation. Write with correct spelling.
Use the necessary tools, including IT tools, to solve any difficulty or problem. Solve problems in specific technologies and know how to propose solutions to new problems.
Effectively carry out assigned tasks as a team member and integrate and participate in group tasks.
Perform interdisciplinary group work. Participate in discussions on technical subjects studied throughout the degree.
Perform internships in public or private organizations and/or companies within the scope of the degree studied.

Manage available tools and content both in the classroom and online, working autonomously and with personal initiative. Know the procedures for searching for appropriate information and know how to select the most relevant information independently.

Develop the ability to plan, lead teams, make decisions, and accept responsibilities. Know how to propose a technical solution with originality and have the capacity to find elements that facilitate its implementation.

syllabus_topics: Internships in companies of the sector
assessment_rules: The current grading system (RD 1125/2003) article 5 will be used, with a numeric scale from 0 to 10. Grades are: 0-4.9 (Fail), 5.0-6.9 (Pass), 7.0-8.9 (Good), 9.0-10 (Excellent). A distinction (Matrícula de Honor) may be awarded to students with a grade equal to or greater than 9.0. The University of Salamanca's Assessment Regulations will be taken into account.
